panels.title: Node Status, Scheduling Capacity and Allocation
panels.description: One row per environment and node: heartbeat reachability, scheduler admission, resource sampling, and CPU, memory and disk scheduling capacity. Unknown means missing observations. Sampling uses node_id, with k8s_node_name as a Kubernetes fallback. Samples older than 45 seconds are unknown (15-second scrape interval). Capacity is zero when admission is disabled. Disk capacity is a scheduling value, not physical filesystem size. CPU, memory and disk allocation bars show reserved / underlying capacity on reachable nodes, including starting and running environments. The underlying capacity is retained when admission is disabled, so existing allocations remain visible even when the scheduling capacity columns are zero. These are allocation ratios, not measured utilization. Zero or missing capacity produces Unknown. Bars use a fixed 0–100% scale; values above 100% remain visible as percentages. Colors: green below 70%, yellow at 70–90%, red at or above 90%.

panels.title: Sandbox Logs
panels.description: Search sandbox main-process stdout/stderr by runtime records and case-sensitive keywords. Runtime IDs contain Sandbox ID and generation. Options come from resource samples in the selected time range; use All for records without samples. SDK command results are not archived here. Defaults to the last 6 hours unless an absolute time range is selected. No main-process output means no log entries.

panels.title: HTTP Request Traces
panels.description: One row per matching HTTP span, showing endpoint, actual component, response status and span duration. Streaming HTTP spans may finish before background tasks; click Trace ID for the complete trace. Excludes unmatched routes and health checks. Does not require an upstream root span.

targets.query: { resource.adx_env =~ "$adx_env" && (resource.service.name = "adx-apiserver" || resource.service.name = "adx-ingress") && name =~ "^(GET|POST|PUT|DELETE|PATCH|HEAD|OPTIONS|CONNECT|OTHER) /.*" && span.http.route != "/unmatched" && name != "GET /healthz" && name != "GET /metrics" } | select(span.http.request.method, span.http.route, span.http.response.status_code, resource.service.name)
